The spread is narrow, so the prompt is judged stable: tunable precision 99.91 to 100.00, tunable recall 99.65 to 99.82 (0.17 points), appendix rate 0.73 to 0.76. One point of headroom, the low end of the procedure's one to two, is several times the observed spread.

Structural finding, all three runs: c06's repeated skill 'Microsoft Excel' (tag duplicate-skill; c06 also carries unusual-sections and typo, which move with it) is quoted once and the repeat left unreferenced, so it goes to the review appendix. Missed in 2, 4 and 3 of c06's four Layouts; single-column and header-footer miss it every run. No text is lost, but it is a labelling defect against the ground truth, not a threshold matter: follow-up ticket 19.

Appendix floor by design: c09 ('Page 1 of 2', 'Fortune favours the prepared.') and c11 (the declaration line, 'Page 2 of 2') send the same unplaceable lines to the appendix in every Layout of every run (tag unplaceable, recall 100). They are most of the appendix rate; the rest is c06's repeat.
One-off, run 3 only: in c04__text-box one profile sentence was placed in additional (profile 1/2, additional precision 2/3). Not repeated in runs 1 and 2; judged sampling variance.

Run 1 is ticket 18's live run on prompt 1.1.0 with the same LabellerConfig; the maintainer counted it rather than paying for a fourth run. Runs 2 and 3 were taken with --no-cache, each with its own cache directory so the best run (run 1) can be replayed.
